summary: Aegon Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing the transcript of its October 8, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, where shareholders considered and approved a redomiciliation of the Bermuda-incorporated insurer to the United States, along with governance changes and an omnibus incentive plan. The chair, CEO Lard Friese, and committee heads presided. No transaction price, stake, or premium was stated; the item was a routine meeting transcript, not a special-situation event. Watch for post-meeting implementation filings and any index or listing implications of the U.S. redomiciliation.
